utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right — the carpool. I haven’t heard any updates yet, but I can ask around and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So you’ll ask around and confirm whether anything changed?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, I’ll ask around and confirm whether anything’s changed. If I hear anything, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll repeat the carpool plan to the others and make sure everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate it. I’m a bit scattered today, so that helps a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll pass it along and keep it simple for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—what time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can swing by around 8:15—does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, 8:15 works for me. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Cleo, what’s the plan for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check who’s bringing snacks and who’s driving, then I’ll send out the carpool plan.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo. That’d be really helpful.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do pickup after 3:15 on school days, if that helps with the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That helps a lot, thanks, Faye. I’ll work your pickup window into the carpool plan.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Jules. Just let me know what days you need me, and I’ll make sure I’m there after 3:15.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I like to keep things simple—what time are you thinking for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Maybe around 7:30? I can double-check and let you know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 7:30 sounds good to me. Just let me know once you’ve confirmed it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia, I’m putting together the carpool list now—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please save me a spot—just let me know the pickup time and where you’re leaving from.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m thinking around 8:15, leaving from my driveway on Maple. I’ll text you if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks — I’m still catching up on the carpool details. What’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course — we’ve got the afternoon pickup at 3:15, and I’m still confirming two seats for Thursday. I’ll send you the final list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, thanks — I’ll watch for your update.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you share the pickup times and any stops? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I say yes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — I can send the pickup times and any planned stops. I’ll message you the details so you can take a look before deciding.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I’d appreciate that. I’ll review the times and stops before I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can still help with the carpool, but I may need to keep things a bit flexible for now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: That works for me — I can be the flexible one too, and I’ll keep you posted on the timing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I appreciate that a lot — just send me the timing when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can help with the carpool if you need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Are you free to pick up the kids on Tuesday?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’m free on Tuesday — I can do the pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep track of that—what time and pickup spot should I note for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Let’s say 7:45 at the corner by Maple and 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — 7:45 at the corner by Maple and 3rd. I’ll note that down for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can help with the carpool if you need a tool or a ride plan sorted out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — I’d appreciate help figuring out the ride plan.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help — let’s map out who’s riding with who and what times work best.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help with the carpool, but I’d like to confirm the pickup time and route first so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds right — can you confirm the pickup time and route for me?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can, but I don’t have the details yet—once you send the pickup time and route, I’ll make sure everything lines up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara — I can help coordinate the carpool if you want, just let me know the timing and who's riding.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — that’d be great. I’ll send you the timing and rider list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — send it over when you’re ready, and I’ll help keep everything sorted.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of who’s riding when. What time are we aiming for, Dane?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll probably be a little late like usual—can we aim for 7:30?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: 7:30 works for me. I’ll note it down and keep an eye on the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, hey Faye — I’m still checking who’s driving the carpool this week. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Tess — keep me posted when you find out. I’m trying to line up the school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’m on it, and I’ll tell you as soon as I hear who’s driving. Hopefully we can get your pickup schedule sorted out soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what’s the carpool plan?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll keep it simple: pick-up is at 8:00 by the corner, and I’ll send the full route list this evening. If anything changes, I’ll let everyone know right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — 8:00 by the corner works for me. Thanks for sending the route list tonight.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what’s the plan for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s meet at 7:30 by the corner, and I’ll drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll be there at 7:30 by the corner.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, I’m putting together the carpool and wanted to see if you want in. If you’re interested, I can share the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please—I'd love the details. I’m a bit new to all this, so I may need the second-hand version too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — the carpool leaves from the corner by Maple at 8:10, and it’s usually just a quick neighborhood run. I’ll send you the second-hand version too, plus the pickup order so it’s easy to follow.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure—where should I note the carpool pickup spot?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Please note it at my front porch at 8:15 AM. That way it’s easy and keeps to the usual routine.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note your front porch at 8:15 AM.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are we still on for the carpool tomorrow? What time should I be ready?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still on for tomorrow. Can you be ready by 7:30 AM?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, 7:30 AM works for me. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Oren, any update on the carpool for this week?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’m still sorting it out, but I’ll check with everyone and let you know soon.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Oren — I appreciate it. Just let me know when you’ve checked with everyone.
